enchantments.tooltip: Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +22 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Insightful Armor-Piercing 11%: Passive: +11% Insight bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Insightful Seeker +7: Provides a +7 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +7 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
